threads.body: [Testing] Removing both legacy capture test tasks leaves no installed-agent run with `otel.instrumentation.opensearch.capture-search-query=false`. The remaining tests would still pass if that setting continued to suppress capture. Reuse `OpenSearchCaptureSearchQueryTest` in a separate JVM with the old setting set to `false` and v3-preview unset, and include it in `check` to verify the documented migration behavior.

replies.body:
No code change.

Analysis: No code in instrumentation/opensearch reads otel.instrumentation.opensearch.capture-search-query anymore; the CHANGELOG states the property is removed with no replacement. A test setting it to false would only assert that an unread property has no effect, i.e. the absence of removed behavior. The v3-preview flag the comment mentions no longer exists in the current code. The PR deliberately removed these tests as redundant in commit 00c70bd.

Upsides: Keeps the build simpler and avoids an extra JVM test task that guards nothing in the current implementation.

Downsides: No automated check proves a leftover legacy setting is ignored; a future reintroduction of the property would not be caught.
